title: Right L4-L5 facet force under 10 Nm pure moments and simulated pelvic obliquity
condition: intact (capsules incised for sensor); pure moment and pelvic-obliquity combined loading

quantity.name: facet force
quantity.definition: peak normal force in the right L4-L5 facet joint (FlexiForce A-201 piezoresistive sensor), mean +- SD, n=8; LB = ipsilateral (right) bending, AR = contralateral (left) rotation

source.authors: Popovich JM Jr, Welcher JB, Hedman TP, Tawackoli W, Anand N, Chen TC, Kulig K
source.sample: 8 specimens (7 L1-sacrum, 1 L3-sacrum); measurements at L4-L5; 8 fresh-frozen human lumbosacral spines (7 L1-S, 1 L3-S) without gross deformity or major degeneration

protocol.summary: Bose Kinematic Spine Testing Device; specimens potted in polyurethane with L4 superior endplate horizontal; pure moments +-10 Nm at 1 deg/s; 5 preconditioning cycles then 3 recorded cycles, 2nd cycle analysed; no preload. Conditions: flexion/extension, lateral bending, axial rotation, and simulated pelvic obliquity = sacrum tilted left 5 deg or 10 deg (lumbar spine in right lateral bending) followed by +-10 Nm axial rotation.
how_to_simulate: Fix sacrum (cranial end loaded; L1 or L3 free); no preload
Apply pure moment +-10 Nm in FL/EX, LB, AR; for pelvic obliquity tilt the sacrum 5 or 10 deg to the left in the frontal plane, then apply +-10 Nm axial rotation
Report peak normal contact force in the right L4-L5 facet (ipsilateral LB, contralateral AR)
protocol.notes: Method: FlexiForce A-201 (Tekscan) force sensor inserted through incised right L4-L5 capsule, overlaid with Fuji Prescale film (placement check) and Kapton tape; calibrated on a materials tester, linear interpolation; only normal force measured; only right facet recorded.

data.load: sacrum 5 deg left tilt + 10 Nm contralateral AR
sacrum 10 deg left tilt + 10 Nm contralateral AR

extraction.uncertainty: +-1 N mean, +-1 N SD (pixel scan at 300 dpi, 3.09 px/N)
extraction.check_notes: Bars and whiskers digitised by pixel scan (bar top = first fully dark row; whisker traced up from bar top). Re-digitised text-reported bars: FL 26.9+-16.2 (text 26.8+-16.1), 10deg 124.3+-30.1 (124.0+-30.2). Text values used where available.
